claims.title: Austronesian settlement of Madagascar
claims.summary: Seafarers from the Borneo region cross the Indian Ocean and become the island's first lasting inhabitants.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-500-austronesian-settlement-of-madagascar, claim TL:MDG:event:500:austronesian-settlement-of-madagascar, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Bantu African arrivals
claims.summary: Migrants from the East African mainland mix with Austronesian settlers, forming the Malagasy people and language.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-700-bantu-african-arrivals, claim TL:MDG:event:700:bantu-african-arrivals, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Swahili and Arab trade contacts
claims.summary: Muslim Swahili traders (the Antalaotra) settle the northwest coast, linking Madagascar to Indian Ocean commerce.

sources.label: Madagascar on the Maritime Silk Roads

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1000-swahili-and-arab-trade-contacts, claim TL:MDG:event:1000:swahili-and-arab-trade-contacts, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Bantu and Tamil arrivals deepen the mix
claims.summary: Bantu-speaking migrants from southeast Africa arrive in numbers alongside Tamil merchants from southern India, drawing the island's population from three continents.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1050-bantu-and-tamil-arrivals-deepen-the-mix, claim TL:MDG:event:1050:bantu-and-tamil-arrivals-deepen-the-mix, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rise of the Sakalava kingdom
claims.summary: The Maroseraña dynasty builds the island's largest realm on the west coast, later dividing into Menabe and Boina.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1610-rise-of-the-sakalava-kingdom, claim TL:MDG:event:1610:rise-of-the-sakalava-kingdom, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Île Sainte-Marie pirate haven
claims.summary: The northeastern island becomes a major base on the pirate 'Round'; legend later names it the site of Libertalia.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1685-ile-sainte-marie-pirate-haven, claim TL:MDG:event:1685:ile-sainte-marie-pirate-haven, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ratsimilaho unites the Betsimisaraka
claims.summary: Ratsimilaho forges the eastern peoples into the Betsimisaraka confederation, becoming a dominant king by 1730.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1712-ratsimilaho-unites-the-betsimisaraka, claim TL:MDG:event:1712:ratsimilaho-unites-the-betsimisaraka, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Portuguese and French trading posts
claims.summary: European powers establish coastal posts but never hold ground inland; the island's kingdoms keep the terms of trade.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1550-portuguese-and-french-trading-posts, claim TL:MDG:event:1550:portuguese-and-french-trading-posts, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Andrianampoinimerina unifies Imerina
claims.summary: From Ambohimanga and Antananarivo, the king ends civil war and begins the conquest of much of the island.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1787-andrianampoinimerina-unifies-imerina, claim TL:MDG:event:1787:andrianampoinimerina-unifies-imerina, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Radama I, Britain and the missionaries
claims.summary: Radama I is recognised King of Madagascar by Britain and admits the London Missionary Society, bringing literacy and Christianity.

sources.label: Royal Hill of Ambohimanga (World Heritage List)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1817-radama-i-britain-and-the-missionaries, claim TL:MDG:event:1817:radama-i-britain-and-the-missionaries, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The London Missionary Society arrives
claims.summary: LMS missionaries open schools, render Malagasy in the Latin alphabet and translate the Bible — literacy arrives with a creed attached.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1818-the-london-missionary-society-arrives, claim TL:MDG:event:1818:the-london-missionary-society-arrives, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ranavalona I bans Christianity
claims.summary: Fearing foreign influence, the queen proscribes Christian practice; persecution and executions follow over decades.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1835-ranavalona-i-bans-christianity, claim TL:MDG:event:1835:ranavalona-i-bans-christianity, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty of peace, friendship and commerce with the United States
claims.summary: Following a commercial convention in 1867, Washington concludes a full treaty with the Kingdom of Madagascar — a sovereign state in the diplomatic record fifteen years before annexation.

sources.label: A Guide to the United States' History of Recognition: Madagascar
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1881-treaty-of-peace-friendship-and-commerce-with, claim TL:MDG:event:1881:treaty-of-peace-friendship-and-commerce-with, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: First Franco-Hova War
claims.summary: France invades and takes Antsiranana (Diego Suarez), the deep northern harbour it had wanted for a generation.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1883-first-franco-hova-war, claim TL:MDG:event:1883:first-franco-hova-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Britain accepts a French protectorate
claims.summary: London concedes the imposition of a protectorate over the island; the government in Antananarivo, never consulted, refuses to accept it.

sources.label: A Guide to the United States' History of Recognition: Madagascar
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1890-britain-accepts-a-french-protectorate, claim TL:MDG:event:1890:britain-accepts-a-french-protectorate, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: French capture Antananarivo
claims.summary: Franco-Hova war ends with the fall of the capital; Madagascar is forced into a French protectorate.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1895-french-capture-antananarivo, claim TL:MDG:event:1895:french-capture-antananarivo, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Monarchy abolished, Ranavalona III exiled
claims.summary: France ends the Merina monarchy and exiles the last queen, ultimately to Algiers, where she dies in 1917.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1897-monarchy-abolished-ranavalona-iii-exiled, claim TL:MDG:event:1897:monarchy-abolished-ranavalona-iii-exiled, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The 'pacification' campaign
claims.summary: The formal declaration of a colony opens fifteen years of French military operations against a resistance that never conceded the point.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1896-the-pacification-campaign, claim TL:MDG:event:1896:the-pacification-campaign, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Battle of Madagascar
claims.summary: British forces invade the Vichy-administered island to deny its harbours to the Japanese navy; the colonial administration's prestige does not recover.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1942-the-battle-of-madagascar, claim TL:MDG:event:1942:the-battle-of-madagascar, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Madagascar becomes a French overseas territory
claims.summary: Reorganisation gives Malagasy deputies representation in Paris; its failure to deliver independence sends nationalists to arms the following year.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1946-madagascar-becomes-a-french-overseas-territory, claim TL:MDG:event:1946:madagascar-becomes-a-french-overseas-territory, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Malagasy Uprising
claims.summary: A nationalist insurrection from March 1947 is suppressed with great loss of life; estimates range up to roughly 90,000 dead.

sources.label: In Madagascar, People Remember One of the Deadliest French Colonial Wars in History

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1947-the-malagasy-uprising, claim TL:MDG:event:1947:the-malagasy-uprising, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence from France
claims.summary: Madagascar becomes a sovereign republic; Philibert Tsiranana is its first president.

sources.label: A Guide to the United States' History of Recognition: Madagascar
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1960-independence-from-france, claim TL:MDG:event:1960:independence-from-france, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The rotaka topples Tsiranana
claims.summary: Economic stagnation triggers mass protests; the first president hands power to a military council, ending the First Republic.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1972-the-rotaka-topples-tsiranana, claim TL:MDG:event:1972:the-rotaka-topples-tsiranana, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ratsiraka and the socialist republic
claims.summary: Didier Ratsiraka takes power, founds the Democratic Republic and nationalises the economy under the 'Red Book'.

sources.label: Didier Ratsiraka: the legacy of Madagascar's 'Red Admiral'

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1975-ratsiraka-and-the-socialist-republic, claim TL:MDG:event:1975:ratsiraka-and-the-socialist-republic, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ravalomanana and the 2002 crisis
claims.summary: A disputed election triggers months of confrontation; Marc Ravalomanana takes power and Ratsiraka flees.

sources.label: Madagascar Timeline: Madagascar's turbulent political history

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-2002-ravalomanana-and-the-2002-crisis, claim TL:MDG:event:2002:ravalomanana-and-the-2002-crisis, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The 2009 coup
claims.summary: Andry Rajoelina ousts Ravalomanana with military backing, in a transfer widely condemned as unconstitutional.

sources.label: Madagascar Timeline: Madagascar's turbulent political history

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-2009-the-2009-coup, claim TL:MDG:event:2009:the-2009-coup, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Third Republic constitution
claims.summary: Democratic reforms end the socialist republic and usher in a new constitution and multiparty politics.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-1992-the-third-republic-constitution, claim TL:MDG:event:1992:the-third-republic-constitution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rainforests of the Atsinanana inscribed
claims.summary: Six eastern national parks — home to species found nowhere else after 60 million years of isolation — join the World Heritage List.

sources.label: Rainforests of the Atsinanana (World Heritage List)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-2007-rainforests-of-the-atsinanana-inscribed, claim TL:MDG:event:2007:rainforests-of-the-atsinanana-inscribed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The rainforests are listed in Danger
claims.summary: Three years after inscription, illegal logging and lemur hunting put the Atsinanana on the List of World Heritage in Danger.

sources.label: Rainforests of the Atsinanana (World Heritage List)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-2010-the-rainforests-are-listed-in-danger, claim TL:MDG:event:2010:the-rainforests-are-listed-in-danger, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Drought and famine in the Grand Sud
claims.summary: The worst drought in four decades leaves over 1.14 million people food insecure and some 14,000 in IPC Phase 5 — catastrophe — in the island's far south.

sources.label: Madagascar's hungry 'holding on for dear life', WFP chief warns

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-2021-drought-and-famine-in-the-grand-sud, claim TL:MDG:event:2021:drought-and-famine-in-the-grand-sud, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rajoelina wins a third term
claims.summary: An election boycotted by ten rivals, preceded by six weeks of protest, returns Rajoelina on the lowest turnout in the country's history.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Madagascar: From Austronesian outriggers to the island republics", terralore.co/country/MDG/chronicle#ev-2023-rajoelina-wins-a-third-term, claim TL:MDG:event:2023:rajoelina-wins-a-third-term, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
